title: PEDNET-LC Home Care – Needs Assessment as Part of the Implementation of Outreach Care for Children and Adolescents with Long COVID-like Conditions and ME/CFS
summary:
Background: Children and adolescents with post-acute infection syndroms (PAIS) like Long-Covid or ME/CFS may become so severely affected that they are rarely able, or entirely unable, to leave their homes. As a result, access to medical or psychosocial care is significantly hindered. To date, there has been little research into how appropriate outreach home-based care should be designed for this patient group. 

Research question: This study explores how affected individuals, their families and caregivers experience current care possibilities, what forms of support they require and what concerns and expectations they have regarding home-based care. 

Methods: Initially, qualitative interviews will be conducted with affected individuals, parents and care professionals involved in outreach care. Based on these findings, a questionnaire will be developed and distributed nationwide across Germany. The findings gained will be used to develop a needs-based home care model for severly affected children and adolescents with PAIS.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Children/adolescents (under 18 years of age, all genders) - Diagnosed with a Long COVID-like syndrome (Long/Post-COVID, PAIS, PAIVS, ME-CFS) - Severe symptoms requiring home care 2. Caregivers (of all ages and genders) of affected children 3. Staff (of all ages and genders) of outpatient services (SAPV-KJ, Bunte Kreise) – medical, nursing, psychosocial – direct patient contact 4. Staff (of all ages and genders) from the nationwide Comprehensive Care Centers (CCCs) of the PEDNET-LC project - medical, nursing, psychosocial - direct patient contact 5. General: Sufficient knowledge of German
Exclusion criteria:
1. Age of the child/adolescent ≥ 18 years 2. No diagnosed Long COVID-like syndrome (Long/Post-COVID, PAIS, PAIVS, ME-CFS) 3. Mild forms of Long COVID-like syndromes (Long/Post-COVID, PAIS, PAIVS, ME-CFS) that do not require home care 4. Outpatient service staff without direct patient contact (e.g., administrative staff) 5. Inpatient care setting (e.g., staff at hospitals and (rehab) clinics, excluding CCCs) 6. Insufficient German language skills
